about: M12.5 decision 6 (plan 7.4 rule 13, 7.16 #180): the TNC 640 cycle manual switches cycle 19 off by defining it again and answering the angle question with NO ENT, which writes an empty CYCL DEF 19.1 (frameEmptyCloses). 19.0 alone still changes nothing; a 19.1 that writes some angles keeps the M10-2 reading (an angle not written keeps its value).

states.about: A move under the tilt (address arithmetic refuses it).
19.0 of the reset names the cycle and changes nothing.
The empty 19.1 (NO ENT) switches cycle 19 off.
The move after the reset is in the untilted plane.
B+0 alone: A+20 still stands, the tilt stays.
Every angle written so far is zero now: closed (M10-2).
A+0 after B+45: B still stands at 45, the tilt stays open.
B+0 sets the last non-zero angle to zero: closed (M10-2).
